caption: The drawing depicts a single brown cup with an irregular surface and some orange spots, positioned centrally on a plain beige background. The cup has a simple, slightly conical shape that widens towards the top and features a small handle on the right side. The handle is also brown, matching the cup, and curls outward. The texture of the cup appears slightly mottled, with areas of darker and lighter brown, as well as scattered orange patches. The interior of the cup is visible, rendered in shades of brown and gray, suggesting some depth. There is a handwritten signature "Aaron Fortney" in the lower left corner of the image. The composition is minimal, with the cup as the only object and no additional elements or background details.
title: Cup
